title: MM6 male peasant 2 / town mage
description: The same middle-aged adult human mage in every pose: shoulder-length dark brown hair, full dark beard and mustache, weathered face, ordinary proportions. Short muted green shoulder cape with pointed back, dark brown near-black sleeveless leather belted tunic, thin ochre rope belt with hanging green pouches, green trousers, dark steel-blue tall boots and wrist bracers, bare upper arms and hands. Plain brown wooden staff with slightly bulbous irregular tip, no jewel or glow. Preserve native clothing, face and exact equipment positions, no new accessories.
regions: Green cape, trousers and pouches; protect warm skin, brown staff/leather, gold rope and cool boots.
